scripts.check: npm run check:router && npm run check:dashboard
scripts.check:router: npm run check --workspace @scope/pr-attention-router && npm run check:policy --workspace @scope/pr-attention-router -- --policy ../../config/pr-attention-router/policy.json --cases ../../config/pr-attention-router/policy-cases.json && npm run check:workflow --workspace @scope/pr-attention-router -- --workflow ../../.github/workflows/pr-attention-review.yml
scripts.check:dashboard: npm run lint --workspace par-dashboard && npm run typecheck --workspace par-dashboard && npm test --workspace par-dashboard && npm run build --workspace par-dashboard
